stem.text: One of the active ingredients in tea-tree oil is terpinen-4-ol.
In the diagram of the skeletal formula of terpinen-4-ol, three of the carbon atoms are labelled **1**, **2** and **3**.
Which of the labelled carbon atoms are chiral?

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of terpinen-4-ol with carbons labelled 1, 2 and 3: OH on carbon 1, a ring C=C double bond next to carbon 2 with a methyl group, and an isopropyl group attached to carbon 1 with label 3 on it.
